shellCommands.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail
node src/server.js > /tmp/book-app.log 2>&1 &
SERVER_PID=$!
trap '"'kill "'$SERVER_PID'"' EXIT
sleep 1

curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ > /tmp/home-before.html
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:3000/books \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \\
  --data 'title=The%20Pragmatic%20Programmer&author=Andy%20Hunt&notes=Great%20so%20far' \\
  -i | head -n 1

BOOK_ID="'$(node -e "const fs=require('"'fs');const books=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8'));process.stdout.write(books.at(-1).id)\")

curl -sS \"http://localhost:3000/books/"'$BOOK_ID" > /tmp/detail.html
curl -sS -X POST "http://localhost:3000/books/$BOOK_ID/finish" -i | head -n 1
curl -sS http://localhost:3000/ > /tmp/home-after.html

kill $SERVER_PID
trap - EXIT

printf '"'Book ID: %s\\n' \""'$BOOK_ID"
rg -n "The Pragmatic Programmer|Currently Reading|Finished" /tmp/home-before.html /tmp/home-after.html /tmp/detail.html
'

/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore && echo '---' && cat > data/books.json <<'EOF'
[]
EOF
cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# Book Tracker

A small local web app to track books you're currently reading and books you've finished.

## Features

- Home page with **Currently Reading** and **Finished** sections
- Add books with title, author, and notes
- Mark a book as finished
- Click any book for its detail page
- Share a direct link to each book detail page ("'`/books/:id`)
- Persistence via `data/books.json` (no database)

## Run

```bash
npm start
```

Then open `http://localhost:3000`.

## Development mode

```bash
npm run dev
```

This uses Node'"'s built-in file watcher.
EOF"
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba package.json && echo '---' && nl -ba README.md && echo '---' && nl -ba data/books.json"
